conditions: TA = 25 C unless a fact states its own condition; electrical values over TJ = -40 C to +125 C unless stated. All facts apply to the fixed 3.3 V variant TLV75533P in the DBV (SOT-23-5, 5-pin) package unless a fact names another package.

sources.document: TLV755P 500-mA, Low-IQ, Small-Size, Low-Dropout Regulator datasheet
sections: 7.1.1 Input and Output Capacitor Selection (printed p. 15)
Package Option Addendum (PDF p. 28, orderable TLV75533PDBVR)

vin_min_v.condition: recommended operating conditions, specified over TJ = -40 C to +125 C

vin_max_v.condition: recommended operating conditions, specified over TJ = -40 C to +125 C

vin_abs_max_v.condition: absolute maximum rating; operation beyond recommended range is not specified

vout_nom_v.applies_to: TLV75533P (33 = 3.3 V fixed output per device nomenclature)
vout_nom_v.condition: nominal fixed output voltage; two-digit voltage code 33 in the ordering number
vout_nom_v.source: SBVS320D, 8.1.1 (printed p. 23) and Package Option Addendum TLV75533PDBVR (PDF p. 28)

vout_tol_pct.condition: maximum output accuracy over the full operating range TJ = -40 C to +125 C; over TJ = -40 C to +85 C the DBV limit is +/-1.0 %

vout_tol_85c_pct.condition: output accuracy over TJ = -40 C to +85 C only (DBV and DRV packages)

iout_max_a.condition: recommended operating conditions, output current range 0 mA to 500 mA

dropout_v.applies_to: TLV75533P (3.3 V <= VOUT < 5.0 V bin), DBV (SOT-23-5)
dropout_v.condition: maximum dropout at IOUT = 500 mA, TJ = -40 C to +85 C; over TJ = -40 C to +125 C the maximum is 0.238 V

dropout_typ_v.applies_to: TLV75533P (3.3 V <= VOUT < 5.0 V bin), DBV (SOT-23-5)
dropout_typ_v.condition: typical dropout at IOUT = 500 mA, TJ = -40 C to +85 C

dropout_max_over_temp_v.applies_to: TLV75533P (3.3 V <= VOUT < 5.0 V bin), DBV (SOT-23-5)
dropout_max_over_temp_v.condition: maximum dropout at IOUT = 500 mA over TJ = -40 C to +125 C

iq_a.condition: typical ground (quiescent) current IGND at TJ = 25 C, IOUT = 0 mA; the same table row also lists 14 uA minimum and 31 uA maximum

iq_min_a.condition: minimum IGND stated in the datasheet table at TJ = 25 C, IOUT = 0 mA

iq_max_a.condition: maximum IGND at TJ = 25 C, IOUT = 0 mA

iq_max_over_temp_a.condition: maximum IGND over TJ = -40 C to +125 C, IOUT = 0 mA (33 uA max over -40 C to +85 C)

cin_min_f.condition: recommended operating conditions; 1 uF or larger ceramic capacitor from IN to GND is required (pin description)
cin_min_f.source: SBVS320D, 5.3 (printed p. 4) and 4 Pin Functions (printed p. 3)

cout_min_f.condition: recommended operating conditions; 1 uF or larger from OUT to GND

cout_max_f.condition: recommended operating conditions; application section says use a maximum output capacitance of 200 uF for best performance

cout_stability_min_f.condition: minimum EFFECTIVE output capacitance for stability after DC-bias derating (datasheet: requires 0.47 uF or larger for stability; derate ceramics by 50 percent); X5R/X7R ceramic recommended
cout_stability_min_f.source: SBVS320D, 7.1.1 (printed p. 15) and 4 Pin Functions note (printed p. 3)

min_load_a.condition: recommended IOUT range starts at 0 mA; the datasheet states no minimum-load requirement and specifies IGND at IOUT = 0 mA

theta_ja_c_per_w.condition: JEDEC standard PCB (2s2p, no vias to internal plane and bottom layer), still air, per 5.4 note 2; this is the worst documented DBV value, use it for conservative estimates

theta_ja_evm_c_per_w.condition: LP087A EVM layout (EVM thermal metrics); not a guarantee for an arbitrary user PCB

tj_max_c.condition: maximum recommended operating junction temperature; the absolute maximum junction temperature is 150 C but operation above 125 C is outside the recommended range

tj_abs_max_c.condition: absolute maximum operating junction temperature; not a recommended operating point

enable_vih_min_v.condition: minimum EN voltage that enables the regulator (VHI); EN is active high

enable_vil_max_v.condition: maximum EN voltage that disables the regulator (VLO)

enable_pin.value: active-high enable; EN independent of IN; internal output pulldown through 120 ohm when disabled; tie EN to IN if unused; driving EN above VIN increases EN-pin current, and EN frequency must stay below 10 kHz

output_discharge_ohm.condition: internal pulldown resistor from OUT to GND when the device is disabled or in UVLO; RPULLDOWN stated at VIN = 5.5 V

uvlo_rising_max_v.condition: maximum VIN rising UVLO threshold (minimum 1.21 V, typical 1.3 V); 40 mV hysteresis

reverse_current_allowed.value: no - reverse current is not permitted; VOUT must remain <= VIN + 0.3 V (absolute maximum, or 6.0 V whichever is smaller); reverse current flows through the pass-transistor body diode and can degrade reliability (electromigration, overheating, latch-up), so TI requires external protection (for example a Schottky diode) if reverse current is expected
reverse_current_allowed.condition: reverse-current conditions listed: large COUT with collapsing input, output biased while input is not established, output biased above input

vout_abs_max_offset_v.condition: absolute maximum VOUT = VIN + 0.3 V or 6.0 V, whichever is smaller

current_limit_min_a.condition: minimum output current limit at VIN = VOUT + VDO(MAX) + 0.25 V; typical 720 mA, maximum 865 mA; short-circuit current 355 mA typical

startup_time_typ_s.condition: typical start-up time only; no maximum is specified

unknown_facts: esr_min_ohm / esr_max_ohm: the datasheet gives no ESR stability window for COUT. It only requires a 1 uF (>= 0.47 uF effective) X5R/X7R ceramic capacitor with low ESR variation; no numeric minimum or maximum ESR is stated and none is recorded here.
Start-up time is specified as a typical (550 us) only; no maximum, so it cannot be used as a hard bound.
No numeric limit on the magnitude of reverse current is stated - only the VOUT <= VIN + 0.3 V absolute maximum plus the requirement for external protection.
Load-transient response (output deviation under a stated load step) is not stated as a minimum/maximum number in the electrical table; only typical characteristic curves are given.

No explicit statement of a maximum capacitive load stability limit in F beyond the recommended COUT <= 200 uF; larger values are outside the recommended operating conditions and are not characterised.
notes: Verified against the current TI datasheet served at the URL above on 2026-10-27 (SBVS320D). Note that devices/SCHEMA.md's example shows an older identifier 'SBVS260 rev B' for a TLV755P-style example; the document actually served for TLV755P is SBVS320D, and that is what these facts cite. The stability limit in 7.1.1 (0.47 uF effective) is lower than the 1 uF minimum in the Recommended Operating Conditions (5.3); both are recorded separately because a generator must not silently choose one. The DBV thermal number 231.1 C/W (JEDEC 2s2p, no thermal vias) is much worse than the EVM number 100.8 C/W: a thermal estimate must name which condition it used and must not be presented as a board-temperature guarantee. The exact orderable TLV75533PDBVR (SOT-23 5-pin, 3000-piece reel) appears in the Package Option Addendum, so the MPN is tied to the DBV package facts.
